follow-up time: Until serum beta-hCG decreased to undetectable levels and menstruation resumed (19-41 days and 10-24 days respectively)
exposure: Ultrasound-guided local lauromacrogol injection combined with aspiration
outcome: Time to undetectable serum beta-hCG levels
cohort: 18 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy.
finding: Ultrasound-guided local lauromacrogol injection combined with aspiration was effective for treating cesarean scar pregnancy, with a high success rate, short hospitalization, and fast recovery in this small case series.
